verdict.rationale: Shared team inboxes are a fair question for an email provider, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of shared mailboxes, shared folders, or team-visible conversation state. The nearest items, logging in to multiple accounts, aliases and a user's mention of easy family setup, are adjacent features rather than shared-inbox collaboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
